title: Quotes received by the requester (as supplied in the project brief)
verification_note: All three figures were supplied by the requester. No government, manufacturer, or contractor-issued document confirming these prices was available for retrieval, so every price cell is UNVERIFIED. Per the verification rule the figures are reproduced for comparison only and are labelled accordingly — they are NOT presented as confirmed market prices.
date_interpretation: Read in US month/day/year order this is 30 August 2026, i.e. approximately 10 weeks before the 2026-11-06 compilation date. Read in day/month/year order the string would be invalid (month 30). Flagged as F-01.

analysis.finding: The three quotes are not the same scope and cannot be ranked on price alone.
analysis.detail: Q-01 is a full waste-and-overflow replacement ($614). Q-02 is a lever + plug + tub-spout-with-diverter replacement ($550). Q-03 is an adjust/repair of the existing plunger handle only ($135). Q-03 is the cheapest because it replaces nothing. Comparing $135 against $614 compares an adjustment against a replacement.
analysis.note: Follows from the wording of the three quotes as supplied in the project brief; the quotes themselves could not be confirmed against any document, so this finding is only as solid as the supplied text.

analysis.finding: None of the three quotes includes drywall opening or patching.
analysis.detail: The project's defining requirement is all-in-one plumbing + drywall because access may have to be made through the wall or through the ceiling of the storage unit below. No quote in the brief contains a drywall line item, so the effective all-in cost is unknown. See flag F-09.
analysis.note: Follows from the wording of the three quotes as supplied in the project brief; the quotes themselves could not be confirmed against any document, so this finding is only as solid as the supplied text.

analysis.finding: The $135 quote is the only one consistent with the stated preferred outcome (no wall demolition).
analysis.detail: An adjust/repair performed through the overflow opening is the only scope that does not imply disturbing concealed piping. The five-plus plumbers already consulted reportedly could not remove the assembly from above without risking the concealed plumbing, which is precisely why the two replacement quotes exist.
analysis.note: Inference from the brief's own scope wording plus the requester's narrative. Not independently verified.

analysis.finding: Zip-code/service-area should be confirmed before price is compared.
analysis.detail: Two of the ten verified providers (P-07 Caccia, P-10 Flow Masters) have an address of record outside San Francisco. Travel/tripline charges are not in any quote.
